messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: autopager fired -> PagerDuty incident PD-8813: node gpu-rc-23 (eu-west-1-prod) reported KERNEL_PANIC and kubelet NotReady. page to #eng-oncall.
Julia Park: acked. I’m on it, switching my phone to do-not-disturb and focusing here.
SRE-Bot: automated runbook started: gathering node diagnostics, attempting soft-reboot, marking node unschedulable. steps: cordon gpu-rc-23; collect dmesg/nvme logs; check kubelet logs.
Amir Khan: I’m pulling logs now. attaching last 30s dmesg snippet.
Amir Khan: ```
[  123.456789] ------------[ cut here ]------------
[  123.456792] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[  123.456795] CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Not tainted 5.18.0-rt x86_64
[  123.456800] Kernel Offset: 0x12345000000 base: 0xffffffff81000000
```
Mateo Ruiz: ugh NVMe errors just before panic in the dmesg earlier. looks like nvme ctrl reset loop.
Priya Shah: kubectl shows kubelet NotReady on that node and multiple model-serving pods in CrashLoopBackOff. getting pod list: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n models -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-rc-23
model-a-5c8fd   CrashLoopBackOff   0/1   10m   10.3.4.12
model-b-7f2ab   Running            1/1   20m   10.3.4.13
```
Julia Park: Start failover: switch traffic for critical routes to model-b and dedicated endpoint fallback. Mateo, can you flip the routing rule for /inference/high-pri to dedicated-capacity-01?
Mateo Ruiz: doing it now (will post command). ```
$ rwdctl routing set --route /inference/high-pri --targets dedicated-capacity-01 --weight 100
Applied. verified at edge: 200 OK from dedicated-capacity-01 for healthcheck.
```
SRE-Bot: automation attempted graceful drain of gpu-rc-23; drain failed (pods not terminating). marking node cordoned. manual eviction recommended.
Amir Khan: I’m going to attach serial console to see if kernel panic left any useful crash dump. requesting serial attach now.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty escalation scheduled: if no resolution in 10m, escalate to oncall-2 (Priya).
Priya Shah: I’m standing by to take over if Julia needs relief. CPU/IO metrics: node shows 100% IO wait spikes just before crash. tagging storage.
Julia Park: Quick customer impact note: we’re seeing increased 503s for model-a routes in eu-west-1; percentage ~6% of requests for last 5m. opening internal ticket CS-4472 for impacted tenants.
Mateo Ruiz: I ran a selective restart on kubelet service via SSH to the host. kubelet restarted but node still NotReady due to kernel oops repeating. logs show nvme reset again.
Amir Khan: NVMe SMART indicates pending sectors and controller errors. likely hardware RMA. I’ll open a support RMA with colocation.
Priya Shah: mitigation steps executed: 1) routed high-pri traffic to dedicated. 2) scaled up dedicated autoscaler by +2 GPUs to absorb load. 3) temporary throttles applied to background jobs.
Julia Park: Good. For incident timeline: initial page at 3472106666, automated cordon/drain attempt at +30s, routing change at +120s, serial attach at +180s. Escalate to hardware RMA and schedule node replacement.
Mateo Ruiz: created infra ticket INF-9021 for node replacement and included dmesg and nvme SMART. RMA requested, ETA 6 hours.
IncidentBot: acknowledgement recorded (Julia Park). escalation to oncall-2 canceled (resolved short-term via routing/fallback).
Priya Shah: Customer comms: I've drafted note to affected customers in CS-4472; recommending failover explanation and ETA for full recovery (6h).
Julia Park: Postmortem owners: Mateo + Amir. follow-ups: add stronger prefix-caching for model-a, add automated model failover to dedicated as a runbook step, and add nvme SMART-based preemptive drain alert.
Amir Khan: will collect kernel crashdump and upload to S3: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/3472106666/crash.dmp
Mateo Ruiz: leaving the thread, continuing with RMA coordination with colo. ping me for handoff.
Julia Park: thanks all. current status: node cordoned, critical traffic routed away, dedicated scaled up, RMA requested. monitoring 503 rate; if it spikes beyond 10% we will open SE involvement.
SRE-Bot: This thread closed for now; reopen if automated checks detect further regressions. :white_check_mark:
